title: DNS Gateway Resolver Configuration
description: Configuration for the dns-gateway resolver UDP listener filter, the DNS-interception half of the dns-gateway extension set.

ipv4Address.description: IPv4 base address (answered as an A record).

ipv6Address.description: IPv6 base address (answered as an AAAA record).

ipv4Range.description: An IPv4 virtual-IP range (answers A queries).

prefix_len.description: CIDR prefix length (1-32). A /24 gives 256 virtual IPs.

ipv6Range.description: An IPv6 virtual-IP range (answers AAAA queries).

prefix_len.description: CIDR prefix length (1-128). A /64 gives 2^64 virtual IPs.

domains.description: Domain matchers, each with its own CIDR range(s) for virtual IP allocation.

items.description: A matcher specifies its range(s) in exactly one of two mutually exclusive forms: the flat single-family form (base_ip + prefix_len) or the explicit form (ipv4 and/or ipv6 blocks, which can serve a domain dual-stack).

domain.description: Exact domain ("example.com"), single-level wildcard pattern ("*.example.com"), or a bare "*" catch-all that matches every queried domain.

metadata.description: String key-value pairs exposed in Envoy filter state as io.builtonenvoy.dns_gateway.metadata.\<key\>. Shared across both families for a dual-stack matcher.

base_ip.description: Flat single-family form. Base address for virtual IP allocation, IPv4 (answered as A) or IPv6 (answered as AAAA); the address family is inferred from the value. Mutually exclusive with ipv4/ipv6.

prefix_len.description: CIDR prefix length for the flat base_ip: 1-32 for IPv4, 1-128 for IPv6 (validated against the base_ip family at config load).

ipv4.description: Explicit IPv4 range (answers A). Combine with ipv6 to serve a domain dual-stack. Mutually exclusive with the flat base_ip/prefix_len.

ipv6.description: Explicit IPv6 range (answers AAAA). Combine with ipv4 to serve a domain dual-stack. Mutually exclusive with the flat base_ip/prefix_len.

fail_open.description: If true, forward queries to upstream resolvers when a CIDR range is exhausted. Default: false (return NODATA, preventing matched domains from leaking to upstream resolvers).
